summary: Well-structured workflow and script with excellent separation of concerns and YAML best practices (pinned actions, least-privilege permissions). Bash script properly uses `set -euo pipefail`, quoting, and error handling. Minor: regex-based XML parsing and sed metric extraction are brittle—don't validate escaped quotes in attribute values or special chars in test names/values. Test ID construction could fail if test names contain pipe delimiter. Sed metric extraction assumes exact markdown spacing (lines 47–51 workflow). XML parser missing namespace support. JSON parser validates structure but not field presence. No evidence of actionlint/shellcheck/act validation shown.
